statements.impact_statement: Mercato exposes REST controllers only. It has no XsltView/XsltViewResolver or server-side wildcard view rendering. CookieSessionIntegrationTest.restApiCannotActivateTheVexExcludedViewRenderingFeatures guards controller and resolver registrations. The public UI is a separately built React app. See Spring's advisory https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/. Reassess this version-specific statement before adding server-side views.

Mercato has no SSE/view-fragment endpoints, SseEmitter, ResponseBodyEmitter or FragmentsRendering handlers. CookieSessionIntegrationTest.restApiCannotActivateTheVexExcludedViewRenderingFeatures guards that invariant. See Spring's advisory https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47890/. Reassess this version-specific statement before introducing SSE or view fragments.
